program.intent: Parse weekday, month, day, time, and year into epoch microseconds and preserve formatting details for exact reconstruction.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    weekday, sp1, month, sp2, day, sp3, time, sp4, year = groups
    text = f"{weekday} {month} {day} {time} {year}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(sp3), len(sp4), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, sp3_len, sp4_len, day_width = layout
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    weekday = dt.strftime('%a')
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    return weekday + (' ' * sp1_len) + month + (' ' * sp2_len) + day + (' ' * sp3_len) + time + (' ' * sp4_len) + year
